findings.title: Explicitly close late non-byte guards for every rendered plot input
findings.code_basis: review_view.render creates separate plot-work/{before,after}-{layer}-input projects and records each protected SVG worker's input-binding. ls.check_event currently checks a plot input once immediately after that worker. These plot copies are outside the source route and fresh-export validation roots.
findings.gap: Step4 asks for experimental preview process/PRL replay, but the late-guard paragraph explicitly replays only source-route p.check_experimental_local_settings and fresh-export guards. It does not require plot-input PRL replay after final tool/material callbacks in rendering, review-copy, choice and export binding. Byte inventories do not detect retained PRL flags or hardlink changes.
findings.counterexample_control: After the ordinary preview proof replay, have the last caller-tool/material callback set UF_IMMUTABLE on review/plot-work/before-F.Cu-input/owned1007-transport.kicad_prl. Keep all bytes and source-route PRLs unchanged. The specified source-route guard and byte witnesses remain equal, so they alone cannot refuse the altered plot-input guard state.
findings.required_closure: After all late tool/full-material reads, replay ls.check_event for each already-bound actual SVG input/process pair. Apply that final non-byte check to render completion and every consumer that retains preview proof. Reuse the existing bindings/events; no new verifier framework or production scope expansion.
findings.focused_regression: Inject that flag mutation after the last tool/material callback in review-copy, review-choice and export-bind/readback, and require refusal/invalidation without a positive canonical outcome. Include plot-input hardlink refusal where the existing host control is supported.
findings.scope_limit: This is a missing explicit prospective closure requirement, not a claim that an implemented1007 patch has executed or failed.

other_reviewed_seams: Caller-selected existing ExperimentalNativeToolchain plus literal full-parity opt-in remains authority; nested receipt context cannot select tools.
Default rejection and exact review/choice/binding/export/preview context propagation are specified, including removal/downgrade negatives.
Default-only explicit export must retain final-netclasses and exact experimental worker prefixes; proposal identifies this producer/reader asymmetry.
Saved-refill/final DRC context and final fullSCH requirements match existing APIs.
Explicit pour-rule-area refusal avoids the current production-only auxiliary reader path; no source repair or version waiver is proposed.
Fresh same-run lineage avoids relocating/rebinding old installed041 evidence; whole180 wall/fullCPU and stage contracts remain prospective bounds.
limitations: Read-only source/proposal review. No completed controls were reinvestigated or rerun. No Native correctness, product admission or test-pass claim.
